description: Converts an hourly wage or range in EUR to a gross monthly range: weekly hours x 52 / 12 when the weekly hours are known, otherwise the standard 160-hour full-time month JobCrawls uses for hourly ads. The result names the basis used. Evening, weekend and shift supplements come on top of an agreement rate and are not included. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

hourlyMax.description: Upper end of a range; omit for a single figure.

hourlyMin.description: Hourly pay in EUR, or the lower end of a range.

weeklyHours.description: Weekly hours the ad states, when it does.

name: convert_hourly_pay

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Hourly pay to monthly
